**Finding: compliant** (rule LD — liquidated damages/penalties payable by Customer).

- Searches for "liquidated damages", "penalty", "interest", "minimum" and "late" returned no customer-payable LD, penalty or late-payment interest provision.
- Section 4 (Fees), Exhibit B (Pricing / Payment Terms) and Section 11 (Term and Termination) impose only earned fees on Corio; termination for breach carries no exit fee or minimum payment, and Section 11.3 merely preserves payment obligations for continued use and support that Corio elects to receive.
- Amounts flowing to us (Commerce One's MarketSite transaction revenue share, Exhibit C support obligations) benefit our party and were deliberately not flagged.

This sits at the preferred position, so no redline was proposed.
